scripts.quick-start: husky && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm exec nx collect @monorepo/developer-portal
scripts.test:coverage: nx run-many -t test:coverage && pnpm --dir infrastructure/scripts exec node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/coverage-report/index.ts
scripts.issue:add: pnpm --dir infrastructure/scripts exec node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/issue/index.ts add
scripts.issue:pick: pnpm --dir infrastructure/scripts exec node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/issue/index.ts pick
scripts.issue:brief: pnpm --dir infrastructure/scripts exec node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/issue/index.ts brief
scripts.check: nx affected --base=master -t nuxt-prepare --outputStyle=static-failures-only && nx affected --base=master -t eslint:lint typecheck test --outputStyle=static-failures-only; s=$?; pnpm docs:map --check || s=1; pnpm review:version --check || s=1; exit $s
